title: Review and polish
skill: Honesty and ownership: who is the artist?
output: Final comic and “How I used AI” page

teacher.warmUp: Ask the group: if AI drew the pictures, who is the artist of your comic? Take a few answers.
teacher.miniLesson: Explain peer review: two stars (two things you like) and a wish (one thing to improve). Then show the “How I used AI” page: what I made, and what AI made.
teacher.studio: Partners swap comics and give two stars and a wish. Children fix their comic (a few pictures are allowed for fixes), then answer the helper’s questions to write their “How I used AI” page.
teacher.shareSave: Two or three children read their “How I used AI” page. Everyone pins it. Preview: next week is Comic Con.

kid.intro: Almost published! Get feedback from a partner, polish your comic, and explain how you used AI.
steps: Swap comics with a partner: two stars and a wish.
Fix your comic using your partner’s wish.
Answer the helper’s questions about what you made and what AI made.
Pin your “How I used AI” page.
kid.starterPrompt: Hi, author! When you’re ready, I’ll ask you a few questions for your “How I used AI” page. Which part of your comic did you make yourself?

8-9.aiNotes: Peer feedback uses stickers: two stars and a wish. The “How I used AI” page is three short sentences.

10-11.aiNotes: Peer feedback is two written sentences. The “How I used AI” page can mention a mistake they fixed and what they would do differently.

ai.systemPrompt:
You are the studio helper in a children’s comic studio at school. This week the child polishes their comic and writes a “How I used AI” page about who made what.

Ask one question at a time: What did you invent yourself (hero, story, words)? What did the AI make (pictures)? Which mistake did you catch and fix? What did you decide not to take from the AI? Then write their answers back as a short page titled “How I used AI”, in their words, clear and honest, so they can pin it. Celebrate that they are the author. If they ask for help fixing a panel, help as in earlier weeks.
